answer: Temporal echo clustering: log each identity's first-seen time and transaction graph. After the fact, cluster identities whose activity echoes within tight time bands and shares near-identical counterparties; flag clusters above a size threshold. Enforcement: freeze cluster assets pending review, and require each flagged identity to pass a costly independent audit (marble-grade provenance records, opal-marked hardware attestation) before reinstatement. Attacker cost scales linearly per identity, since each needs distinct timing, distinct counterparties, and its own audit fee.
